Book.title: Backrooms
Book.author: llydia
Book.Page:
LizziesMod_Backrooms is a generated-dimension companion for LizziesMod. It registers the backrooms terrain generator and defines the Backrooms destination in Config/Dimensions.xml.
When this companion is installed, its default priority selects Backrooms as the ordinary Dimensional Portal destination. The dimension system is experimental, single-player only, and requires ExperimentalFeatures to be enabled before a portal can activate.
The generator creates persistent rooms and corridors above a concrete foundation. Generated chunks are stored separately from the Overworld save.

The Backrooms Access Terminal is a direct portal: it always targets Backrooms instead of following the configurable default portal destination.
Craft it at a workbench with 3 Flux Cells, 12 Electrical Parts, 8 Mechanical Parts, and 6 Forged Steel. Place and use it in the Overworld to enter the dimension. Using the terminal while already in a dimension returns the local session to the Overworld.
Back up a save before testing dimension transitions. Settings marked as requiring restart apply after restarting the client.

MainFloorY sets the normal room floor from 16 through 200. StoreyHeight controls room clearance and upper-storey elevation from 4 through 8.
PitDepth determines the depth of the internal pit-wall footings below MainFloorY, from 4 through 12. The pit floor sits one additional block lower, leaving a crawl space under those walls. BasementCorridorHeight sets clearance at pit entrances and is limited by PitDepth. SplitLevelDepth controls the deepest point of split-level rooms from 1 through 4.
The pit floor is calculated as MainFloorY minus PitDepth minus one, so those values remain consistent with the crawl space.

Layout changes affect newly generated chunks only. Restart after changing settings, then recreate the Backrooms realm before testing a new layout.
While in the Overworld, run lizziesregendimension Backrooms. It creates an Overworld backup, archives the old Backrooms Region directory, and creates an empty Region directory for fresh chunks. Do not run it while inside Backrooms.
Keep the generated-realm data isolated from ordinary save maintenance and return to the Overworld before ending a session.
